dentalcharz.html.description: DentalCharz connects dental case intake, production, clinic portals, shipping and invoicing. Explore the flagship software product from Probotz Consultancy Oy.
dentalcharz.html.body:
DentalCharz · A Probotz product

From impression to invoice.

One connected operating platform for dental laboratories, their clinics and manufacturers. Keep the digital case and the physical work moving together.

Discuss DentalCharzExplore the workflows

Built around the case

The details stay with the work.

DentalCharz follows a case across people, systems and physical handoffs, so each stage has the context it needs.

01 / Intake

Turn incoming work into a configured case

Receive clinic and practitioner requests with physical or digital impressions, scans and attachments. Configure products and tooth-level prescriptions, with QR codes linking the physical case.

Medit Link integration and synchronisation support scanner-originated intake, automatically or manually, with product mapping to help prepare the draft.

02 / Production

Coordinate the next step

Move cases through statuses and production stages with assignments, priorities, holds and alerts. Keep case conversations and production files attached to the work.

Coordinate lab, clinic and manufacturer handoffs, including outsourced work, turnaround information and delivery expectations.

03 / Logistics

Keep physical work traceable

Organise clinic-to-lab and lab-to-clinic shipments, combine work into shipment batches and prepare labels through the Posti integration.

Physical case codes and component or increment tracking connect what is being made and shipped to the digital case.

04 / Commercial workflow

Invoice the work fulfilled

Build a configurable catalogue with product options, tooth-level prescriptions and clinic-specific price lists. Live estimates give context while an order is configured.

Fulfilment-based invoicing, invoices and credit notes carry the work into billing, with VAT, payment terms and Maventa electronic invoicing.

05 / Clinic portal

Give clinics a clear view

Branded portals bring practitioner and clinic access, case communication, files, status and delivery visibility into one place.

Custom domains, colours, logos and a multilingual interface let the portal fit the laboratory's customer experience.

06 / History & documentation

Keep the record connected

Case history and production records support auditability. Manufacturer information and custom-made device documentation stay connected to the case in supported workflows.

Discuss your documentation requirements when configuring DentalCharz for your laboratory.

A workflow example

One case, from scanner to invoice.

An illustrative path through DentalCharz. Intake and handoffs depend on the laboratory's configuration.

  1. Scanner case

    A Medit Link case arrives with its scan files.

  2. Configured draft

    Mapped products and the prescription are reviewed.

  3. Production

    Work is assigned, with files and communication in context.

  4. Fulfilment

    Components are completed and prepared for shipment.

  5. Invoice

    Fulfilled work moves into billing and electronic invoicing.

work.html.body:
Customer work

Focused work.
Different contexts.

Alongside DentalCharz, Probotz designs and builds digital solutions for organisations with their own practical challenges.

Association website · Inkoo, Finland

Jousiammuntaseura Falcon

A modern replacement for an ageing Weebly site, designed and developed by Probotz for a Finnish archery association.

The need

A clearer welcome.
A place for history.

Falcon needed a public website that made sense to someone discovering the club for the first time, while keeping years of existing content and historical material accessible.

The work centred on familiar questions: how to start archery, where to train, where to find competition information and how to contact the club.

What Probotz built

A practical new home for the club.

Navigation around visitor needs

A Finnish-first structure with clear routes to starting archery, training, competitions, club information and contacts.

History carried forward

Existing historical material and results documents migrated into a dedicated archive, keeping past achievements accessible.

A responsive club identity

A new interface with a visual identity suited to Falcon, layouts for mobile and desktop, and attention to accessibility.

Deployment and domain setup

Modern deployment and the domain/DNS work needed to bring the new site online.

Project scope

The right size for the problem.

This is a focused association website project: information design, content preservation and a clearer public experience. It shows another side of Probotz's work alongside the more extensive operational software in DentalCharz.

The new public website is being prepared for launch.

about.html.description: Probotz Consultancy Oy is a focused Finnish software company building DentalCharz and tailored digital solutions around real workflows.
about.html.body:
About Probotz

Software starts with understanding the work.

Probotz Consultancy Oy is a focused software company based in Finland. We design and build products and digital services for problems that need more than another generic tool.

Practical by design

A useful system needs to reflect the details of the work: who needs which information, where responsibility changes hands and what happens when the process takes a different route.

We start there. We simplify the workflow, design the experience, build the software and connect external services where needed. Deployment and operation are part of making the solution useful.

One company, more than one kind of work

DentalCharz is our flagship product: a connected operating platform for dental laboratories. It brings intake, production, collaboration, logistics and invoicing into a shared case workflow.

We also take on selected customer projects. Our work for Jousiammuntaseura Falcon applies the same attention to structure and usability to a smaller challenge: a new website for an established archery club, with its history preserved.

Built to fit

The answer might be operational software, a web application, a portal or a clearer website. The aim is to build what the problem calls for and make it work well in practice.

Discuss your workflow
